organization.notes: Project established 2015 per homepage, separate from predecessor Attic. Donations/fiscal host are not equity financing. Waldmann EDV is lead maintainer Thomas Waldmann’s company and donation recipient; community project not owned by fiscal host.

moats.claim: Long repository histories and mature Unix metadata handling can increase migration effort, while the open format and license limit vendor lock-in.

productReasons.claim: Content-defined chunking deduplicates data across files, machines and archive history.
FUSE-mounted archives allow browsing historical files as a regular filesystem.
Authenticated encryption and selectable compression suit encrypted archival workflows.

sponsorship.notes: Arcanite made documented2023/2024 financial contributions; SWEETGOOD made observedMay–July2026 monthly contributions. OpenCollective totals are cumulative, not all current recurring payments. WaldmannEDV remains business steward, not an outside financial donor; unverified business identities excluded.

resources.os: Linux, macOS, BSD; Windows WSL/Cygwin experimental
resources.notes: Hardware depends on chunk/file counts and cache indexes; resource-usage guide provides workload-dependent guidance, not a universal numerical minimum.

selfHosting.notes: Stable 1.4.5 docs. Standalone binary bundles dependencies; Python/compiler/library headers are source-build requirements, not extra services for standalone binary. No external database or queue.

oneClickInstall.notes: Checked official installation documentation; manual installation/Compose alone is not a one-click offering.
